scope: Retrospective verification of a conditional endpoint diagnostic. No new production formula, accuracy gain, official equivalence or notification readiness is claimed.
reproducibility: Published source-free helpers and synthetic tests are directly runnable. Complete source reparses and archive-based drivers require the previously collected private calendar archives. Hashes identify those inputs; they do not make those archives publicly available.

independentFreeQuotientProjection.method: Independent rational vertex LPs in (t,Bf,Bi) on each open envelope/horizon cell, plus fixed-t (Bf,Bi) vertex LPs at every knot. Strict source/physical/time facets are tested on the full objective face; no perturbation.py or root driver/imported elimination is used.
independentFreeQuotientProjection.note: All reported signed feasible-shift unions and minimum/infimum distances matched exact LP reconstruction.

independentFixedQuotientProjection.method: Independent exact rational LP projection of (t,z) per open envelope cell, with independent interval constraints at knots; retained half-open rounded source bands and strict Nprime>0. No fixed_quotient.py, project_second, or evaluate_fixed.py imported.
independentFixedQuotientProjection.conclusion: Every fixed-q signed correction set and global infimum/attainment matched the frozen report; all 168 sets were contained in the matching free-q sets; zero-shift counts replayed as 13/16/19.

berlinOriginalSourceAndQuartetReplay.method: Original source reparse plus independent exact rational projection from each two-cell pair to endpoint values; exact piecewise-linear continuous feasibility proof over [b−3,b+3], including every horizon/source knot, every lower/upper bound intersection, and interval midpoints. It does not trust saved zeroShiftFeasible booleans or root feasibility code.

helsinkiBranchInterpretation.conclusion: Sep 11 raw-angle and seasonal predictions both round to source 22:14. Crossing onto the endpoint does not change the rounded minute for Sep 11. Sep 10 seasonal value is one minute later than source; Sep 12 angle value matches source. Removing Sep 11 from tie constraints removes the diagnostic contradiction, but this is not a correction or validation.

emptyCertification.issue: Initial certificate flag was true for an empty source-line case because both bounds were empty. No physical witness exists in that case.
emptyCertification.correction: Require feasible lower/upper sets before marking an independent-horizon bound certified. All numeric feasible sets and case counts stay unchanged. Remove an unused empty comprehension.

positiveToleranceAssertion.issue: Initial independent_check.py asserted that full-run feasibility status should equal feasibility status after positive vertical tolerance. That expectation was wrong: the full Helsinki run is tie-only infeasible under the three real tie policies, while delta=1/1024 must be feasible.
positiveToleranceAssertion.fix: Changed the independent assertion to explicitly require positive-tolerance feasibility under every tested tie policy, including closed-bin relaxation.
